notes: Rebalanced monthly using only data that would have been published by each month-end.

The rules use textbook settings (200-day trend, 12-month momentum) and were not fitted to this data. The Nasdaq period is an out-of-sample check: a different index and 25 more years, including the 2000-02 and 2008 crashes.
Stocks: index price change plus an assumed dividend yield (1.6% S&P 500, 1.0% Nasdaq).
Bonds: a 10-year Treasury approximation (yield income minus duration times the yield change).
No taxes, fees or trading costs. Uses today's revised data, not the figures first reported.
